Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gui.background

Interface MenuBackgroundCondition

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface MenuBackgroundCondition
A condition an add-on adds to the when of menu background rules in guis.yml.

Server owners write it under the add-on's namespace, namespace:name (see nameOf(Plugin, String)), anywhere a built-in condition such as permission may stand. For a condition registered as myranks:rank: 

 - when: { myranks:rank: gold }                 argument "gold"
 - when: { myranks:rank: [gold, "!trial"] }     every one must hold; "!" means "not"
 - when: { myranks:rank: true }                 argument "" (false asks for the opposite)
 - when: "myranks:rank(gold) and page > 1"      argument "gold"; several are all tested
 - when: "not myranks:rank"                     argument ""

The argument is what the owner wrote, trimmed; what it means is up to the add-on. A condition that throws counts as false and is reported in the console once.

Since:
1.15.0

      @NotNull static @NotNull String nameOf(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin owner, @NotNull @NotNull String name)
      The name server owners write for a condition or value a plugin registers: the plugin's name in lowercase, with every character outside a-z, 0-9, _ and - replaced by _, then a colon and the name.
